intent.summary: Represents or edits a scalar value within a bounded numeric interval.
useWhen: A value is meaningfully bounded and relative position matters
avoidWhen: Exact unconstrained numeric entry is primary

semantics.childPolicy: no visual children; associated labels are peers
semantics.sizing: minimum operable track length or available parent extent
semantics.ordering: minimum to maximum follows axis and locale direction

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Whether the element is interactive or display-only.

constraints.message: Value must be inside the interval.
Step must be positive when supplied.

accessibility.role: slider for editable mode; progress indicator otherwise
accessibility.focusBehavior: focusable and keyboard-adjustable only in editable mode
notes: Expose current, minimum, maximum, and formatted value.

mappings.strategy: Normalize editing mode, bounds, step, and value presentation.
Select an interactive Slider or display-only ProgressBar from mode.
